trust_decision.summary: Whether ImageRef.uri values inside an untrusted DoclingDocument JSON may point at local files (bare/relative paths, file: URIs) that later stages open and embed; at the pinned commit the JSON backend accepts any URI unchecked, and the fix decides it in DoclingJSONBackend after parsing, gated by backend_options.enable_local_fetch (default False).

landing_point.why: The summary names 'crafted DoclingDocument JSON'; the only place docling parses JSON input into a DoclingDocument is this backend's model_validate_json call.
